    Mat(int n = 0) : N(n), A(n+1, vector<int>(n+1, 0)) {}
    Mat operator*(const Mat& B) const {
        Mat C(N);
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; ++i)

            }
        return C;
    }
};

        N /= K;
    }
    int cnt = dig.size();
    vector<vector<Mat>> A(cnt, vector<Mat>(K, Mat(K)));
    vector<vector<Mat>> sum(cnt, vector<Mat>(K, Mat(K)));
    vector<vector<Mat>> suf(cnt, vector<Mat>(K, Mat(K)));

    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {

        }

    }

    for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) sum[0][i] = sum[0][i-1] * A[0][i];
    suf[0][K-1] = A[0][K-1];
    for (int i = K-2; i >= 0; --i) suf[0][i] = A[0][i] * suf[0][i+1];

        sum[i][0] = A[i][0];
        for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j) sum[i][j] = sum[i][j-1] * A[i][j];
        suf[i][K-1] = A[i][K-1];
        for (int j = K-2; j >= 0; --j) suf[i][j] = A[i][j] * suf[i][j+1];
    }

    Mat ans(K);
